name: xue-mint
description: Private photo backup: local server, desktop app, web gallery and shared UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run build -w @xue-mint/web && npm run build -w @xue-mint/mobile && npm run build -w @xue-mint/desktop && npm run prepare:resources -w @xue-mint/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run dev -w @xue-mint/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run tauri:build -w @xue-mint/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run test -w @xue-mint/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run lint -w @xue-mint/web && npm run lint -w @xue-mint/mobile && npm run lint -w @xue-mint/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run typecheck -w @xue-mint/web && npm run typecheck -w @xue-mint/mobile && npm run typecheck -w @xue-mint/desktop
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
